The maximum absolute eigenvalue (spectral radius) is $\rho(P)=1$. The largest real eigenvalue is $\lambda_{\max}(P) = 1$ (corresponding to $k=0$, where $\lambda_0 = 1$).

args.code:
import numpy as np

def cyclic_permutation_matrix(N):
    P = np.zeros((N, N))
    for i in range(N):
        # Successor is (i + 1) % N
        P[i, (i + 1) % N] = 1
    return P

N = 4
P4 = cyclic_permutation_matrix(N)
eigenvalues = np.linalg.eigvals(P4)
print(f"Eigenvalues for N={N}: {eigenvalues}")
print(f"Max real eigenvalue: {np.max(eigenvalues.real)}")
